q: What gives you Ruff findings as you type in the editor?
why: The editor plugin talks to ruff server.

q: In .pre-commit-config.yaml, ruff-check uses --fix. Where does it go?
why: Fixes can leave code that the formatter then tidies.

q: Which flag makes GitHub show findings as notes on the pull request?
why: GitHub Actions turns that format into inline notes.

q: Why pin the Ruff version (rev, uv add --dev ruff)?
o: New versions can change defaults and fail unchanged code
why: Ruff 0.16 grew the default rule set from 59 to 413 rules.

q: Adopting Ruff on an old repo: what goes in its own commit?
o: The CI step and the fixes together
Nothing; do it all at once
why: It touches many lines but no behaviour, so it is easy to review and skip.

q: CI must go green today, but 50 old findings remain. Which command helps?
why: It writes a noqa on each remaining finding, to remove later.
